label: PF Backlog 457
title: WorkerGrid: thin client (/wg work) - drop lease/worktree/status; coordinator as fallback
body:
Child of the parallel-run-engine epic. WorkerGrid becomes a THIN runtime host: one verb, no server, no
lease, no store.

Scope: (1) /wg work (loop) + --once; drop the separate agent verb (keep as alias); (2) the Go agent calls PF's
assignment API: claim -> write .wg/assignment.json (assignment package) into the worktree -> run the runtime
command (cwd = worktree) -> heartbeat -> complete/fail; (3) DROP its own lease/worktree/status-write (PF owns
them); (4) runtime wrapper script (opencode run --agent build --auto --format json -f .wg/assignment.json "...")
documented; (5) keep the coordinator (Stage 3a/3b/3c) as the FALLBACK for producers without the assignment API;
(6) implicit registration (worker id + token), no /wg serve needed for PF.

Descriptors: module:workergrid/wg.py; module:workergrid/internal/agent/agent.go; module:workergrid/_cfg.py;
test:test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_workergrid_pf_client.py; command:workergrid/wg.py.

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; fast precheck PASS (18 gates, incl. wg-go which now runs the new pf-client e2e). Agent gains contract=auto|pf-assignments|coordinator; in PF mode it claims via PF's assignment API, writes .wg/assignment.json, runs the runtime in PF's worktree, heartbeats + completes/fails via PF (no coordinator/lease/status). /wg work = the worker (exec-shim); --claim-only keeps the old claim. /wg status proxies PF GET /engineering/assignments. Added POST /engineering/assignments/recover. Coordinator kept as fallback. e2e: test_workergrid_pf_client.py.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/release.py, core/release_manager.py, core/run_status.py, core/status.py

dashboard_impact.reason: Operator surface is /wg status + the PF API (assignments view); the dashboard is a separate surface and stays out of this slice
